status: Source and synthetic design only; no actual market evaluation authorized by this document

provenance.motivation_received_from_parent: The retained adverse V2 development baseline exhibited frequent support-family infeasibility. V2b separately studies a one-time best-effort action after infeasibility. This later version instead changes only the primary temporary destinations, retaining V2b protection as it was.

single_intervention: Replace the four primary temporary target weights a*w+(1-a)*e_bill by a*m*w+(1-a*m)*e_bill for the same fixed a=1,.75,.5,.25. All other decision/account/selection rules, including the original unscaled V2b fallback, remain fixed.

state_formula.variables: R=sum(current nominal holdings)/current cumulative CPI, P=original running historical real peak, d=1-R/P, L=client original maximum drawdown tolerance.
state_formula.state_not_parameter: m is a deterministic current-state transformation of original L/R/P, not a fitted hyperparameter, psychological preference or independently selected risk aversion. It adds no candidate family to the existing six release_fraction/forecast tuples.
state_formula.interpretation: Original-floor headroom is scaled by L*R. At the original peak m=1; at the original floor m=0. For 0<L<1 it decreases with current d, with derivative (L-1)/(L*(1-d)^2) before clipping. Positive monetary scaling of R and P leaves m unchanged.
state_formula.zero_loss_boundary: For L=0 use the explicit convention m=1 at R>=P (including the existing tolerated numerical comparison), otherwise m=0. Active helper consistency and the absorbing actual-breach rule still apply; this convention does not weaken the floor.
state_formula.unit_loss_boundary: For L=1 and positive current real wealth m=1.
state_formula.tiny_negative_headroom: m clips to0. The unchanged primary budget floor remains max((1-L)*P, R-rho*(R-(1-L)*P)); it is never lowered below the original floor by a tolerated tiny breach.

destinations_and_execution.initial: Initial admission still permits only full original w, with its original exact fee, or preinvestment Review/financial NULL. Initial m is exactly1 and there is no cash substitute.
destinations_and_execution.continuation: At each active funded noninitial decision rebuild the same four temporary destinations a*m*w+(1-a*m)*e_bill. The base Q1 target is not persistently reset.
destinations_and_execution.risk_sleeve: The new destination equity/bond proportions are a*m times their original w proportions; original bill allocation is also retained in the convex combination. This is not a separate leverage or risky-dollar formula.
destinations_and_execution.same_postdollar_segments: For each destination execute_target gives exact full after-fee endpoint y_star. The existing segment y(q)=x+q*(y_star-x), fee(q)=q*fee_star, and exact support interval are unchanged. Evaluate only lo/mid/hi in each interval plus separate hold, still13 candidates.
destinations_and_execution.same_objective: Uniform scores E log(W_candidate/W_hold); ensemble_min scores the minimum of the same paired expectation across the frozen five forecasts. Hold feasible still requires a strictly positive selected paired score above1e-12 to trade. Risk protection when hold is infeasible still records any growth sacrifice and fees.
destinations_and_execution.same_tie: Global maximum score band1e-12, then hold, lower actual fee, less cash tilt/proposal order, fixed point order.
destinations_and_execution.same_fallback: Only if the changed primary still has no feasible declared point, call the frozen V2b mitigate_support_failure directly. Its original four unscaled a*w+(1-a)*e_bill endpoints and q=.5/1 remain exactly9 points including hold. Its max-min after-fee objective, strict1e-12*R improvement, residual shortfall and absorbing Review are unchanged.

boundaries.not_hold_cap: m restricts new temporary destinations only. A support-feasible current hold may keep more risk exposure than every destination when no new safe trade offers sufficient paired gain. There is no compulsory liquidation.
boundaries.replacement_not_superset: At m<1 the destination family replaces rather than contains the previous family. Lower risky destinations can supply a safe point that was absent before, but prior high-growth points can disappear. Neither feasibility, growth nor realized risk is monotone between versions.
boundaries.not_cash_safe: The bill real gross return can be below1; even m=0, exact transaction fees and negative real bill returns can leave the same-year support floor infeasible.
boundaries.not_CPPI_or_floor_insurance: The formula does not establish a hard exposure constraint, CPPI guarantee, recursive feasibility, future support containment, pathwise maximum drawdown guarantee, or intrayear protection. It is only a deterministic proposal generator followed by the original exact one-step support filter.
boundaries.unchanged_certificate_scope: A feasible primary decision certifies only the declared training joint-support one-step floor, under the already declared numerical convention. A guard/mitigation action retains support_feasible=False even if shortfall improves; actual future events remain out of support and may breach L.
boundaries.numeric_convention: Exact mathematical intervals add no slack; eligibility allows the unchanged1e-12 relative-to-R support roundoff. Actual runningMDD crossing uses MDD-L>1e-12. Do not turn either numerical tolerance into a substantive risk budget.
boundaries.past_breach: A recovered current d does not remove an earlier runningMDD breach. Already breached or guard-pending accounts get no new cushion action or protection rescue.
boundaries.no_new_claim: This document makes no empirical improvement, novelty, admission, certification or final-data performance claim. A full frozen development evaluation and independent audit are still required.

API.pure_primary: decide_state_action has the frozen primary signature, validates the same unbreached current state, changes the four destinations only and adds cushion_scale/proposal_target_weights.
API.simulator: simulate_state_budget has the frozen V2b signature and funded/Review wrapper; alias simulate_state_budget_cushion.
API.implementation: The new pure module copies frozen V2 primary source without its simulator, modifies destination construction and witnesses only. The new simulator/wrapper copies V2b source but imports the new primary explicitly and frozen V2b mitigate_support_failure directly. No old source/module global is edited or monkeypatched.

new_arm_fields.cushion_scale: float(n,originalH); NaN for a period without an active primary calculation
new_arm_fields.proposal_target_weights: float(n,originalH,4,3); actual temporary destination weights, NaN in pending periods

API.other_fields: All standard financial arrays, primary13 witnesses, original9 fallback witnesses, actual_decision_source, original hold/pending state, forecasts and actual realized post-decision market traces retain their prior meanings. New arrays are readonly with the other saved arm arrays.
